entries.printed_type:
@StochasticAbstraction.runLaw_preserves : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} (K : A → X → PMF X) (q : X → R)
  (L : A → R → PMF R),
  StochasticAbstraction.Exact K q L →
    ∀ (word : List A) (x : X),
      PMF.map q (StochasticAbstraction.runLaw K word x) = StochasticAbstraction.runLaw L word (q x)

entries.name: StochasticAbstraction.runLaw_initial
entries.printed_type:
@StochasticAbstraction.runLaw_initial : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} (K : A → X → PMF X) (q : X → R)
  (L : A → R → PMF R),
  StochasticAbstraction.Exact K q L →
    ∀ (word : List A) (μ : PMF X),
      PMF.map q (μ.bind (StochasticAbstraction.runLaw K word)) =
        (PMF.map q μ).bind (StochasticAbstraction.runLaw L word)

entries.name: StochasticAbstraction.experiment_preserves
entries.printed_type:
@StochasticAbstraction.experiment_preserves : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} (K : A → X → PMF X)
  (q : X → R) (L : A → R → PMF R),
  StochasticAbstraction.Exact K q L →
    ∀ (choose : StochasticAbstraction.Policy X A) (chooseR : StochasticAbstraction.Policy R A),
      (∀ (past : List (X × A)) (x : X), choose past x = chooseR (StochasticAbstraction.mapHistory q past) (q x)) →
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (past : List (X × A)) (x : X),
          PMF.map (StochasticAbstraction.view q) (StochasticAbstraction.experiment K choose n past x) =
            StochasticAbstraction.experiment L chooseR n (StochasticAbstraction.mapHistory q past) (q x)

entries.name: StochasticAbstraction.experimentLaw_preserves
entries.printed_type:
@StochasticAbstraction.experimentLaw_preserves : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} (K : A → X → PMF X)
  (q : X → R) (L : A → R → PMF R),
  StochasticAbstraction.Exact K q L →
    ∀ (choose : StochasticAbstraction.Policy X A) (chooseR : StochasticAbstraction.Policy R A),
      (∀ (past : List (X × A)) (x : X), choose past x = chooseR (StochasticAbstraction.mapHistory q past) (q x)) →
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (μ : PMF X),
          PMF.map (StochasticAbstraction.view q) (StochasticAbstraction.experimentLaw K choose n μ) =
            StochasticAbstraction.experimentLaw L chooseR n (PMF.map q μ)

entries.name: StochasticAbstraction.observationPolicy_factors
StochasticAbstraction.observed_experiment_law
entries.printed_type:
@StochasticAbstraction.observed_experiment_law : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {O : Type u_3} {A : Type u_4}
  (K : A → X → PMF X) (q : X → R) (L : A → R → PMF R),
  StochasticAbstraction.Exact K q L →
    ∀ (p : X → O) (d : R → O),
      (∀ (x : X), d (q x) = p x) →
        ∀ (chooseO : StochasticAbstraction.Policy O A) (n : ℕ) (μ : PMF X),
          PMF.map (StochasticAbstraction.view p)
              (StochasticAbstraction.experimentLaw K (StochasticAbstraction.observationPolicy p chooseO) n μ) =
            PMF.map (StochasticAbstraction.view d)
              (StochasticAbstraction.experimentLaw L (StochasticAbstraction.observationPolicy d chooseO) n
                (PMF.map q μ))

entries.name: StochasticAbstraction.observed_statistic_preserves
entries.printed_type:
@StochasticAbstraction.observed_statistic_preserves : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {O : Type u_3} {A : Type u_4}
  {B : Type u_5} (K : A → X → PMF X) (q : X → R) (L : A → R → PMF R),
  StochasticAbstraction.Exact K q L →
    ∀ (p : X → O) (d : R → O),
      (∀ (x : X), d (q x) = p x) →
        ∀ (chooseO : StochasticAbstraction.Policy O A) (n : ℕ) (μ : PMF X) (statistic : List (O × A) × O → B),
          PMF.map statistic
              (PMF.map (StochasticAbstraction.view p)
                (StochasticAbstraction.experimentLaw K (StochasticAbstraction.observationPolicy p chooseO) n μ)) =
            PMF.map statistic
              (PMF.map (StochasticAbstraction.view d)
                (StochasticAbstraction.experimentLaw L (StochasticAbstraction.observationPolicy d chooseO) n
                  (PMF.map q μ)))

entries.name: StochasticAbstraction.deterministic_instance
entries.printed_type:
@StochasticAbstraction.deterministic_instance : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} (T : A → X → X)
  (q : X → R) (G : A → R → R),
  (∀ (a : A) (x : X), q (T a x) = G a (q x)) →
    StochasticAbstraction.Exact (fun a x => PMF.pure (T a x)) q fun a r => PMF.pure (G a r)

entries.name: StochasticAbstraction.joint_sensor_exact
StochasticAbstraction.joint_sensor_observed_law
entries.printed_type:
@StochasticAbstraction.joint_sensor_observed_law : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {O : Type u_3} {A : Type u_4}
  (J : A → X → PMF (X × O)) (q : X → R) (Jbar : A → R → PMF (R × O)),
  (∀ (a : A) (x : X), PMF.map (StochasticAbstraction.sensorCode q) (J a x) = Jbar a (q x)) →
    ∀ (chooseO : StochasticAbstraction.Policy O A) (n : ℕ) (μ : PMF (X × O)),
      PMF.map (StochasticAbstraction.view Prod.snd)
          (StochasticAbstraction.experimentLaw (StochasticAbstraction.sensorStep J)
            (StochasticAbstraction.observationPolicy Prod.snd chooseO) n μ) =
        PMF.map (StochasticAbstraction.view Prod.snd)
          (StochasticAbstraction.experimentLaw (StochasticAbstraction.sensorStep Jbar)
            (StochasticAbstraction.observationPolicy Prod.snd chooseO) n
            (PMF.map (StochasticAbstraction.sensorCode q) μ))

StochasticExamples.c_is_mixture : ∀ (n : ℕ),
  StochasticExamples.trace n StochasticExamples.State.c =
    StochasticExamples.coin.bind fun bit =>
      StochasticExamples.trace n (if bit = true then StochasticExamples.State.b else StochasticExamples.State.u)
